title: Dodge
duration: Until the start of your next turn
description:
You settle into a guard and read what your opponents mean to do.

Choose one of the two effects.

***Parry.*** {{attaque|Attacks}} made against you suffer 1 {{desavantage}}.
***Sidestep.*** Your {{reflexes}}, {{resistance}} and {{volonte}} {{jet|Rolls}} gain 1 {{avantage}}.

The effect ends as soon as your {{vitesse}} drops to 0.
